import RNA

target = ".......((.((.((....)).((...))...)))).((.((.((....)).((...))...)))).((.((.((....)).((...))...))))......."
print("len", len(target))

# Build candidate from decomposition
# positions: units placed, linkers A-rich, junction closing pairs G-C
# Layout (0-indexed):
# 0-6: .......
# 7,8: ((
# 9: .
# 10,11: ((

# 29,30,31: ...
# 32: )   wait need to recount

# I'll construct manually with GC closing pairs and stable caps
# tetraloop cap GAAA, triloop try GAA
# Sequence positions (0-indexed):
seq = ['A']*103

# Helper to set pair (i,j) as G-C and loop bases
def set_pair(i,j): seq[i]='G'; seq[j]='C'
def set_pair_cg(i,j): seq[i]='C'; seq[j]='G'

# Structure parse
pairs=[]
stack=[]
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif c==')':
        j=stack.pop()
        pairs.append((j,i))
print("pairs", pairs)

# Assign all pairs G-C
for (i,j) in pairs:
    seq[i]='G'
    seq[j]='C'

# Loops: place stable caps

# unpaired linkers -> A
# (already A by default)

s=''.join(seq)
print(s)
print(len(s))

# Fold
fc = RNA.fold_compound(s)
ss,mfe = fc.mfe()
print("MFE", mfe)
print(ss)
print("match", ss==target)

# bp distance
import RNA as R
fc2=R.fold_compound(s)
fc2.params = R.md()
fc2.mfe()
# bp distance
dist = R.bp_distance(ss, target)
print("bpdist", dist)
